message.title: Prosafe SE   Issue of new shares and settlement of RSUs
message.body:
Oslo, Norway, 29 September 2026.

Reference is made to the resolution made by the board of directors of Prosafe
SE ("the Company") of 29 September 2025, where the board resolved to grant
certain individuals a number of restricted stock units (RSUs) under the
Company's long-term incentive program ("LTIP").
On 28 September 2026 the board resolved to issue 303 590 new shares as
settlement of the RSUs that vest on 30 September 2026.
In accordance with the vesting plan for the Company's RSU program, some of the
RSUs have been exercisable into shares while the Company has chosen to
cash-settle the portion of the RSU awards that represent the tax cost for the
relevant recipient.
The following primary insiders of the Company have received a total of 231 047
shares from the settlement of RSUs, as specified below:

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reese Worth McNeel, CEO - 118 122 new shares                               |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Ryan Stewart, CCO - 80 316 new shares                                      |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Claudio Pereira, COO -17 897 new shares                                    |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Halvdan Kielland, CFO - 14 712 new shares                                  |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Reese Worth McNeel already holds 4 000 shares and, following the issue, will
hold a total of 122 122 shares in Prosafe SE.
Ryan Stewart already holds 73 shares and, following the issue, will hold a
total of 80 389 shares in Prosafe SE.
Please see the attached forms of notification and public disclosure for
further information.

Contacts
For further information, please contact:
Reese McNeel, CEO
Phone: +47 415 08 186

About Us
Prosafe is a leading owner and operator of semi-submersible accommodation and
construction support units.
 The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with ticker code PRS. For
more information, please refer to https://www.prosafe.com
(https://www.prosafe.com/)

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act §
5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the
agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-29 20:18 CEST.
